location_description: Alexandria ( or ; Arabic: ٱلْإِسْكَنْدَرِيَّةُ al-ʾIskandarīyah; Greek: Αλεξάνδρεια, translit. Alexándria) is the second largest city in Egypt after Cairo. It is a major Mediterranean port city of Egypt.
